notes.title: Sneak Peek: DunHero's Biggest Update Yet!
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

I'm the developer of DunHero, and I'm thrilled to finally share what I've been working on for the upcoming 1.0 Patch. The biggest update yet!

This massive patch is still a Few Months Away, but it’s already shaping up to completely transform the game. It will feature brand new worlds, new classes, powerful new items and item sets, reworked systems, and huge amount of content to help you create the most fun and powerful builds possible.

Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming:

🌌Mana System Rework
From now on, we gain mana when we hit enemies with magic weapons and lose it quickly when we are not fighting. The more mana we have, the more damage we inflict

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/122cd2916ca732476b355b1d5a126b8dce3dda43.gif

🏝 3 New Worlds
Discover the Volcanic Wasteland, Frozen Lands, and Toxic Lands each with their own enemies, bossess and atmosphere.

🌀 Summons & Orbitals
Summon creatures that fight by your side

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/ba510d2e89fc52b741cc84ab3592f5c175db2e0b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/f5310950f05fe6c12395d16d6718fe40bfeafccd.gif

🎒Equipment Capacity System
A new stat-based system that encourages smart gear choices and deeper build strategy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/7ed7fdebb91ab80687c4d84067b8a5c20b57f451.png

📈 Better Stats
Now DEX, INT, and STR each grant minor secondary bonuses, allowing for more synergy between your gear and playstyle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/c93988ccae12ef329ca5b47b92f557b739cb93c6.gif

🧤 New Item Types: Boots & Gloves
More gear slots = more build variety! You can now find Boots and Gloves with powerful effects to create even more synergies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/0f28a6555698b3e0ed3fb5b4515f047dcc701f13.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/35fef5cdbb57c25740498735ed0c674e43da2439.png

⚔ 150+ New Items (and more to come!)
From now on, there will be many more items in the game. Many of them have also been reworked to provide players with the openness to create powerful synergies and builds

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/86f4744f0de02c0217526cdecbd7147053184ab0.png

Aura System
A new aura system has been added that deals damage to all enemies around you. There will also be several items and cards that increase aura damage

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/be81f666a64913ea1a6761fcb50dfa59e8632b68.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/c3e1ae97d30d314c851f0b9c03a9e62fbf02d099.gif

🃏 New Cards & Level-Up Choices
Dozens of new cards to choose from, with a focus on build identity and cool effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/d3800bd4dc8c00c11b8ac5f6fa5ed1d4396ddd66.gif

🧙 New Classes
There will be new classes such as Summoner, Druid, Monk, Warlock, and more...

🧠 Improved Tooltips & Clarity
All item and card descriptions are being rewritten and clarified, so you always know what your gear does.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/b71e5f50bbb42efa097cc39a4d45e71a592d172c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/665b58e74c6c7563b5b4c1ab92c25e26d7c4bab7.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/ea4d6ba3c1d53b18698a38d091ad2114c5a7221e.png

And Much More
- QoL Improvements
- Rebalanced Enemies
- Better enemy attacks and interactions
- New NPCs
- And more things to discover...

If you enjoy DunHero, don’t forget to wishlist, review, or share the game. it helps a ton!

Thanks for playing, and see you in the next realm!
- Dev Kacper

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483125/2149e7f811ca282b38974f5304d026e019e9dd94.gif

What's New?
- All maps are now smaller to make gameplay more dynamic and overall run time quicker
- Improved world generation. Now it would be much faster (In multiplayer it can be a little longer due to sending all the packets to clients)
- Added Secret Rooms (???)
- A Town has been added, which is a new type of world that can be accessed through a second portal on the first stage of each world. In the town there are only NPCs and bandits
- Updated chances for rare cards. For example, if you have high strength the chance of rare cards related to strength will be higher

- Reworked Death screen and Victory screen

- Added enemies defragmentaion when defeated
- Updated cards description
- Rebalanced some of the rare cards
- Added new interaction with bandits
- Dash Cooldown is changed from 3s -> 5s
- Now all chests can be destroyed by bombs
- Now all rocks are destroyable by explosions only
- Added that Large enemies destroy walls and doors when approaching them
- Added new locations
- Added new controls settings
- Added selecting button scheme for gamepads
- Now all throwable projectiles will be destroyed in contact with wall
- Added new stat Durability which, in addition to armor, blocks the % of damage received
- Now to provoke an NPC you need to hit him 2 times or hit him harder
- All furniture is now a little more durable
- NPCs will now not react at destroying for example chests from outside of their house
- Now when NPCs, or enemies destroy houses it takes them less time to do so
- Increased IFrames time after taking damage
- Updated some UI elements
- [Multiplayer] Now Player Ghost have collision with environment and can't leave map 
- Alchemist passive ability which gave him stats is now weaker, because it could let to having massive amount of stats
- Fixed Lucky Sword description
- Quivers now have in description that they only work on Bows and Crossbows
- Chance for prison to spawn is lowered

notes.title: DunHero Update 0.3.2
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!
To be honest, in recent weeks I have been a bit ill which has slowed down my work. But I'm back to work at 100% capacity and hope to add another patch soon :)

Plan For Next Patch
As the current patch focused mainly on QoL and fixes. It is in the next patch that I want to focus on adding new items to create more interesting builds, a new character and a variety of locations.

What's next?
I will most likely be adding some smaller updates to version 0.3.X in December/January. After that I want to start working on a huge update. That huge update will pretty much expand content by a lot.

In this patch it is planned to include:
- 3 new worlds
- Rework of the item system and a large number of new ones
- New classes
- New Item Types: Boots and Gloves
- And many more...

But going back to current patch...
What’s New?
- Added icon to hired characters

- Added new items 11 (215→226)

notes.title: About Update 0.2 and current Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

Welcome to my development update! I'm excited to bring you a sneak peek of what’s coming in Update 0.2. This update is packed with major additions and transformative changes that we hope will enhance your experience.

Key Highlights for Update 0.2

Check out the major features planned for the upcoming update:

https://i.imgur.com/udxjC5Q.png

Certainly! Here's how you could format the descriptions of your game features for Steam, using  headers for better readability:

NPC Rework: Enhanced Diversity and Dynamics

We’re excited to enhance the diversity and richness of our game world with a comprehensive NPC rework. In Update 0.2, you'll encounter a wider variety of NPCs and discover them in new, unexpected locations each run, making every game experience unique and immersive.

Hard Mode: Intensify Your Challenge

Ready to test your mettle? The new Hard Mode introduces tougher challenges with each run. Choose from a variety of hard mode options and face more formidable enemies and adverse events that will require your best strategies and skills to overcome.

Meta Progression: Unlock Power with Hero Medallions

Elevate your starting point in every run with our new Meta Progression system. Use Hero Medallions to acquire superior starting gear, enhance your statistics, and unlock many other exciting upgrades. This system not only rewards your achievements but also ensures continual improvement and variety in your gameplay.

I'm committed to refining the game based on your feedback and introducing new content that makes your adventure even more thrilling.

Looking Ahead: Future Updates

But that’s not all—I'm already planning beyond Update 0.2. Here’s a glimpse into what’s in store for the future updates:

https://i.imgur.com/qSzJRFD.png

Stay tuned for more detailed updates as we progress. Your support and feedback are invaluable to me, and I'm eager to hear what you think about the new changes!
